crossRefs.note: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”
Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, and a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to…
Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
crossRefs.keyword: uncertain, but its name declares it nature

translations.web: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.
translations.bsb: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so that I can make them into a tasty dish for your father—the kind he loves.
translations.kjv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
translations.asv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats. And I will make them savory food for thy father, such as he loveth.
